name: @alloflow/remediation-remote-mcp
description: Stateless Streamable HTTP MCP gateway for AlloFlow document remediation.

scripts.deploy:staging: npm run runner:stage && npm run runner:stage:check && npm run preflight:staging && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.pilot.local.jsonc
scripts.deploy:staging:accepted: npm run runner:stage && npm run runner:stage:check && npm run preflight:staging:accepted && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.pilot.local.jsonc
scripts.types: wrangler types --config wrangler.jsonc && wrangler types pilot-configuration.d.ts --config wrangler.pilot.example.jsonc --env-interface PilotDeploymentEnv --include-runtime false --strict-vars false
scripts.types:check: wrangler types --config wrangler.jsonc --check && wrangler types pilot-configuration.d.ts --config wrangler.pilot.example.jsonc --env-interface PilotDeploymentEnv --include-runtime false --strict-vars false --check
scripts.check: npm run runner:stage:check && npm run types:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run preflight:test && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler-build
scripts.runner:check: npm run runner:stage:check && npm run runner:test
